Vivek / team — I reviewed Acme’s PDF and sketched recommended language. High-level thoughts:

1) Fee pass-through: we can accept a pass-through for Marketplace fees if we limit it to fees actually charged to Redwood by the marketplace provider (i.e., no additional indemnity). Proposed short clause: "Marketplace fees charged to Redwood and invoiced to Distributor may be passed through to Customer as a separately itemized charge; Redwood disclaims liability for Marketplace provider actions beyond its control."

2) Escrow carve-out: an open-ended escrow concession is risky. Recommend a time-boxed exception: 90-day escrow hold for onboarding disputes, with an obligation for Customer to submit dispute evidence. Alternative is a cap (e.g., $25k) for the escrow relief.

3) Audit evidence: ops can produce invoice CSVs and tokenized usage reports but we should avoid committing to full raw logs. Proposed wording: "Redwood will provide commercially reasonable billing evidence (invoices and usage CSVs) upon request for reconciliation."

I attached a short doc with tracked suggestions: redlines_legal_notes.docx (Word, edits inline).

If Acme wants stronger audit rights we should escalate to Security for review — that will add time.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi Alex — thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. We did an internal review and can propose the compromise below to move this forward quickly:

- Fee routing: Redwood will include a separate Marketplace fee line on Distributor invoices where the Marketplace provider charges Redwood directly. Language: "Marketplace fees charged to Redwood by third-party marketplace providers may be passed through to Customer as a separate, itemized charge. Redwood does not assume liability for third-party marketplace actions beyond those expressly stated in this Agreement."

- Escrow exception: Redwood can agree to a temporary escrow carve-out for onboarding disputes limited to 90 days from go-live OR a cap of $25,000 (whichever is lower). That should limit our risk while addressing Acme’s concerns.

- Audit evidence: Redwood will provide invoices and usage CSVs for reconciliation. If Acme requests raw logs or SOC2-level evidence beyond standard billing materials, we’ll route to Security and provide a timeline.

I attached a short one-page proposed amendment (proposed_of_amendment.pdf) with the exact language to insert in the Order Form. If that looks OK to you we can:
1) get legal to do a clean redline for signature,
2) prepare DocuSign, and
3) ops will confirm invoice format (example CSV) post-signature.

Would you prefer a quick 20-min call this week to lock the language?

Thanks,
Vivek
